feature_contract.goal: Keep both-eye gameplay HUD geometry steady through XR extent publication, recenter and desktop fallback without mixing old and new eye sizes.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only gameplay HUD XR extent publication snapshot, not unrelated F11, menu producer, SkyGlow, world or FFB pipelines.
trace_stages: OpenXR host state_->recommendedWidth/Height published between Begin/End
R29 game-side SharedPoseState reader and coherent binocular cached dimensions
R30 HUD containment geometry, producer-specific XYZRHW/per-eye mapping and stereo composition
subcomponents: Coherent atomic four-value binocular extent read in game DX9Ex R29 owner
R30 HUD aspect cache invalidation and safe FOV-only fallback during host resize/recenter

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: At 4:3/16:9/21:9 source and Quest3 eye extents, both HUD eyes consume one host seqlock generation.
An odd/busy or incomplete extent publication yields all-zero pair and FOV-only safe fallback; desktop unaffected.
Same material SHA passes DX9Ex Active Win32 host/game/package, Domain Isolation and Full Source Impact.

runtime_note: No actual Quest3/VDXR test; no visual or frame-rate success assertion.

diagnosis.original_evidence: Host publishes both recommendedWidth/Height arrays under one SharedPoseState Begin/End seqlock; prior R30 did two unsynchronized R29OwnerRecommendedEyeExtent per-eye calls.
source_trace: OpenXR host allocation source publishes two equal eye dimensions under odd/even sequence.
R29 reads separate four dimension fields without shared generation validation.
R30 compares aspect/cache and draws per-eye XYZRHW hud, risking short-term mismatched aspect near resize.
diagnosis.root_cause: Four individual reads were not guaranteed to belong to the same host publication while XR extent changes.
alternatives_rejected: Existing 10% left/right dimension comparison cannot catch a cross-generation mix for small resizing.
Existing FOV fallback handles invalid extent but cannot detect a plausible nonzero mixed snapshot.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: R29 consumes one coherent four-field seqlock snapshot; R30 caches or falls back as a unit.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Verifier adds odd/changed sequence, partial right eye, invalid header, reset and 7 destructive mutation checks.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: R30 HUD containment applies a synchronized extent to each eye without changing unrelated game-world projection.
